paragraphs: Rabbi Nechemyah bar Mar Ukban, son of R' Yose.

He is mentioned in [Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 14:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yevamot.14.1.5) and quoted in [Tosafot on Yevamot 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Yevamot.113b.6.1), s.v. Yatzetah. Tosafot gives the statement as Rabbi Nechemyah’s report in the name of R’ Yehudah.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew gives 153a. [Hyman’s print](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=94) gives 113a. The quoted Tosafot comment is on 113b.

Tosafot names Rabbi Yehudah as the cited authority. [The Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Yevamot.14.3.1) names Rabbi Yose, and [the Rashba](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashba_on_Yevamot.113b.1) names Rabbi Yisa.

The linked Yerushalmi Hebrew says “son of Rabbi Yose,” while Guggenheimer’s translation follows the Rosh’s “in the name of Rabbi Yose.” [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2663&lang=en) gives Rav Yosef. The heading leaves the attachment of “son of” open.
